# UpshiftArk

## UpshiftArk
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/contracts/arks/UpshiftArk.sol)

**Inherits:**
[ArkWithWithdrawalRequest](../ark-with-withdrawal-request.md)

**Title:**
UpshiftArk

Ark contract for managing token supply and yield generation through an Upshift TokenizedAccount.

Implements strategy for depositing tokens, requesting withdrawals, and claiming if necessary.


#### totalAssets

Returns the total assets managed by this Ark


```solidity
function totalAssets() public view override(Ark, IArk) returns (uint256 assets);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`assets`|`uint256`|Sum of withdrawable assets, shares in Ark, and assets in withdrawal queue|


#### assetsInWithdrawalQueue

Returns the underlying assets claimable in the pending withdrawal request.


```solidity
function assetsInWithdrawalQueue() public view returns (uint256);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|assets The amount of underlying assets currently pending withdrawal.|


#### requestWithdrawal

Request redemption of shares from the Upshift pool

Only one withdrawal request can be active at a time to maintain strict atomicity.
A new request can only be submitted once the previous claimable amount drops to 0.


```solidity
function requestWithdrawal(uint256 amount) external onlyKeeper;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|Amount of token to withdraw|


#### claimWithdrawal

Claims an existing pending withdrawal

As long as the the withdrawal time has passed, the keeper can claim funds that haven't
been processed automatically by the Upshift operator.


```solidity
function claimWithdrawal() external onlyKeeper;
```

#### isWithdrawalClaimRequired

Returns whether a withdrawal claim is required for this Ark.

It's a keeper helper method to check if a claim is required.


```solidity
function isWithdrawalClaimRequired() public view returns (bool);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|required Whether a withdrawal claim is required.|
